sources.detail: All 6 pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched live by direct curl with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 212-371 KB each. Parsed the <table class="tier-list"> rows: first <td> = tier letter, then each <span class="tier-list-entry"> block's FIRST img alt = "Spec Class" (which ignores the spell-icon alts inside the expandable details). 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, each spec exactly once per page. Era-verified per <title>: "Midnight DPS Rankings: Raiding Tier List (Midnight (12.0.7))", "...(Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight)", "Midnight Tank Rankings: Season 1 Tier List (Patch 12.0.7 / Season 1)"; Devourer present in both DPS lists; the handful of "Season 2" hits on each page are sidebar links to the PTR lists, never the tier block. The pages' OWN dates are unchanged and still trail our fetch: JSON-LD dateModified 2026-07-01 (raid DPS), 2026-06-30 (raid healer + raid tank), 2026-07-01 (all three M+) — so this is a live re-verification of a static upstream list, not new editorial movement. 0 tier moves vs committed.

All 3 PTR M+ pages fetched live (dps/healer/tank), HTTP 200, 221-358 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as the skill requires: every <title> reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)", never Season 1. The page's own date is unchanged — JSON-LD dateModified 2026-07-26T10:53 on all three — so sources.json published stays 2026-07-26 while snapshot (our fetch cadence) advances to 2026-08-02. Upstream rebuilds Sundays 14:00 CEST, so a 7-day lag is the documented normal; it is now AT the edge of that window and a human should note that one more quiet Sunday would make it the ~2-week freeze the skill calls a finding. Six-band scale seen intact (S/A+/A/B+/B/C; B+ present on all three pages). 40 rows written: 38 rated + the 2 upstream TBDs kept as EXPLICIT nulls — Augmentation Evoker (DPS page TBD row) and Vengeance Demon Hunter (tank page TBD row), both re-confirmed in this fetch rather than assumed. 0 tier moves. Never enters the consensus (era-gated in the registry).

All 6 pages fetched live, HTTP 200, 80-315 KB, via direct curl carrying the full browser header set (Accept, Accept-Language, sec-ch-ua*, sec-fetch-*, upgrade-insecure-requests) — plain-UA curl is Cloudflare-403 on these paths, the header set is what clears it. Parsed the [tier-list=rows] block out of the raw document after unescaping \/ to /, splitting on [tier] and reading [tier-label]<letter> plus every [spec-badge=<slug>], which sidesteps last run's two-printHtml-call gotcha entirely by never anchoring on a WH.markup call. 80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, M+ DPS A+ tier present (4 specs). Era-verified: every <title> reads "for Midnight Season 1"; 0 "Season 2" occurrences inside the tier block on any page. Raid DPS S tier and several D/F tiers are genuinely empty upstream — same shape as committed. 0 tier moves.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag (specTierListSection.tierLists), raid = the throughput tierList and M+ = score, resolving each entry from its Class-Spec icon token. 80 rows, 0 unmatched, no duplicates. Archon HAS re-stamped since the last run: lastUpdated advanced 2026-07-31T12:00:00Z -> 2026-08-01T12:00:00Z on all 6 pages (still a coarse daily label — it reads 08-01 on an 08-02 fetch). Titles still read "Midnight ... VS / DR / MQD Tier List" (Season 1 raids) and "Midnight ... Mythic+ Tier List", no Season 2. Total parses 406670 raid DPS / 2566888 M+ DPS. THIRTEEN tier moves, every one in the RAID throughput list, every one exactly ONE band and every one DOWNWARD: Unholy DK, Subtlety Rogue, Elemental Shaman, Enhancement Shaman, Demonology Warlock, Destruction Warlock, Arms Warrior and Devastation Evoker A->B; Havoc DH, Balance Druid, Marksmanship Hunter, Survival Hunter and Windwalker Monk S->A. Zero M+ moves. This is a re-clustering at the top of the raid list, not a Blizzard retune — the underlying 95th-pct DPS numbers moved only fractionally (see archon-metrics) while Augmentation Evoker and Devourer DH pulled clear at 183.6k/179.9k, which lifts the S/A cut line and pushes the band edges down under everyone else. No anomaly ack proposed: 13 total, 0 two-band, inside the gate's 25/6 limits.

Full re-fetch of all 9 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, every one HTTP 200 and every encounter parsing a complete 40/40 specs (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank), so nothing was written from a partial page — the merge refuses any encounter under 40. Each page's selectedEncounter was checked against the requested slug: 17/17 matched, so no silent redirect to an aggregate view. 680 tier cells written, 40 changed, all confined to the RAID side and consistent with the same aggregate re-clustering: imperator 15 cells, vorasius 5, vaelgor-ezzorak 5, crown 4, chimaerus 4, beloren 4, vanguard 3. Re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList): "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" = 33 rows (27 raid DPS + 6 tanks; the healer page also exposes a dps column but healer damage stays deliberately excluded, matching the committed series shape), each carrying n = that row's parses count, values rounded from the raw float. Range 89421-183590 (was 89690-183284). The moves are fractional across the board and far below the gate's maxValueMovePct — which is exactly why the 13 one-band tier drops above are read as a band re-cut rather than a retune. 33 rows against a floor of 25.
